cells.title: Overview
cells.source: Model **ABM-BMW** is Godley and Lavoie Model BMW populated by many households. Each household holds bank deposits, forms its own disposable income, and has its own propensity to consume. Firms invest via a capital accelerator; banks create deposits when they lend. Macro totals emerge by summing over agents. The R reference is `references/leeds_lectures_2026/ABM_BMW.R`.
cells.more:
Aggregate and IO models are **top-down**. **Agent-based models (ABMs)** are
**bottom-up**: many households, with macro variables obtained by _summing over
agents_.

Relative to ABM-SIM / ABM-PC, Model BMW adds **private bank money**, a
**capital stock**, and an **investment accelerator**. When hiring friction
cuts output below demand, investment is rationed first — and lower output
feeds back into a lower capital target, amplifying the recessionary bias.

Stock-flow check: household deposits `M_h` track bank deposit supply `M_s`
(and loans `L`). Charts show Monte Carlo **means** with p10–p90 bands.
Frictionless BMW steady state is about `Y = 200`, `I = 20`, `K = 200`,
`M_h = 200` at the default parameters.

cells.title: ABM-BMW specification
cells.description: Declarative agent-based BMW: heterogeneous households, job lottery, FCFS goods market with investment served first, residual wage bill. Tick order matches Leeds ABM_BMW.R. Upper-case = MACRO (MC means); lower-case / `*_h*` = MICRO from MC run 1 only.
cells.more:
**Macro vs micro (Leeds convention).**

- **Macro**: every aggregate tick variable is stored as a Monte Carlo mean
  (banded p10–p90).
- **Micro**: first and last household state from **MC run 1 only**.
- **MC count**: set on the run cell as `abm.monteCarlo`.

Stock-flow check: `|M_h - M_s|` must stay within `tolerance` every period.

**Period ticks.** One period unfolds as the ordered tick list below: firms plan
investment from the accelerator, households plan consumption, hiring via a job
lottery sets output, investment is served first then households
first-come-first-served, residual wages are paid, and banks create deposits to
fund net investment.

1. Depreciation `DA = delta * K`. Planned investment
   `Ipl = max(0, gamma * (kappa * lag(Y) - K) + DA)`.
2. Each household plans `cd = max(alpha0/N + alpha1 * yd + alpha2 * m, 0)`.
3. Total demand `D = sum(cd) + Ipl`. Labour needed `Ln = D / pr`.
4. Hiring lottery sets `Nemp` and output `Y = Nemp * pr`.
5. Realised investment `I = min(Ipl, Y)`; remaining goods are rationed FCFS.
6. Wage bill `WB = Y - rl * L - DA` is split equally among the employed.
7. Deposits update as `m = m + yd - c`. Capital and loans rise by net investment
   `I - DA`; banks create matching deposits.

households: max(alpha0 / households.size + alpha1 * yd + alpha2 * m, 0)

do: min(min(floor(Ln * random.uniform(1 - s, 1 + s, 1)), floor(Ln)), households.size)
Wage bill = residual after interest and depreciation

descriptions.alpha2: Propensity to consume out of wealth (deposits)
descriptions.gamma: Speed of adjustment of capital to its target
descriptions.alpha1: Propensity to consume out of income

cells.title: ABM-BMW balance sheet (MC means)
cells.description: Household deposits equal bank deposit liabilities. Firm capital is financed by bank loans. In this simplified BMW, `M_h = M_s = L` and `K = L`.

cells.title: ABM-BMW transactions-flow matrix (MC means)
cells.description: Period flows among households, firms, and banks. Use the period scrubber after the run.

cells.title: Monte Carlo baseline
cells.description: ABM-BMW Monte Carlo (mean paths). Defaults match the Leeds R script except `households: 200` and `monteCarlo: 12` for a snappier browser run (R uses 500 households and 50 MC runs).

cells.title: Output Y
cells.description: MACRO output `Y` (MC mean with p10–p90 band). Dashed frictionless BMW steady state is about 200 at these parameters (R panel a).

cells.title: Consumption
cells.description: MACRO consumption `C` (MC mean with p10–p90 band). R panel b.

cells.title: Investment and depreciation
cells.description: MACRO realised investment `I` and depreciation `DA` (MC means with bands). R panel c.

cells.title: Capital stock
cells.description: MACRO capital stock `K` (MC mean with p10–p90 band). R panel d.

cells.title: Deposits (= loans)
cells.description: MACRO household deposits `M_h` (MC mean with band). In this BMW closure deposits equal loans (R panel e).

cells.title: Unemployment rate (emergent)
cells.description: MACRO unemployment rate `UR` (MC mean with p10–p90 band). Emerges from the job lottery when `s > 0` (R panel f).

cells.description: MICRO paths for household 1 from MC run 1 only: consumption `c_h1`, deposits `m_h1`, employment `e_h1`.
